title: Three Years and One Short Chair
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：man　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 man 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the partner ① knew the man that no stranger in the yard would have recorded, and he said the knowing was the whole of the year. The ② man, meaning the fellow itself and not the chair, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a man, he said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ man in that yard had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ man at the far gate, meaning the guest they kept for the children to meet and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A man, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the partner said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the man was the whole of the matter, meaning the company and not the fellow. The ⑥ man, meaning the company and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; man, he said, is either something you know or the only word that means both a fellow and a company. He said the company is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ man had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ man of the whole thing, the partner wrote in March, was one yard and three years of recording; man, he said, is either the guest at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ man I remember is the fellow recorded in the letter, which closed in 1962 and is still recorded as the quietest in the yard. A ⑩ man, my mother said in 1964, is the only fellow that improves by being recorded; every man, she said, is a company that has agreed to look like a fellow. She said the company was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 男人；男子（指院子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 男人；男子（指那个男人本身，与板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：know the man 认识这个人
D. n. 男人；男子（指留给孩子们见的那一位那一个）
E. n. 相交之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的男人之事）
F. n. 男人；男子（指旧信里写到、被记述的的那一个）
G. n. 陪伴、情分（指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情分（抽象总称，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: knew the man that no stranger in the yard would have recorded
The man, meaning the fellow itself and not the chair
the man at the far gate
the man was the whole of the matter

answers.why: know the man 意为“认识这个人”，1955 年那位老伙计把院子里没有一位生人肯记述的一个男人做了一遍。
man 意为“男人；男子”，指那个男人本身而不是板凳，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记述。
man 意为“男人；男子”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
man 意为“男人；男子”，指最远那道院门留给孩子们见的那一位那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
man 意为“陪伴、情分”，指一件事里人人都认却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份陪伴就是那件事的全部。
man 意为“情分”，指人人都认却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个男人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
man 意为“男人；男子”，指旧信里写到、被记述的的那一个，到 1960 年这一个成了旧信里的一行。
man 意为“相交之事”，老伙计三月写道，整件事的男人之事是一处院子和三个年头的记述。
man 意为“男人；男子”，我记得的是旧信里记述过的那一个，1962 年走完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
man 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，男人是唯一会因为被好好记述而变得更好的男人。
